body.statement: For every \(\eta\in\mathcal C(\mathcal O)\) and every \(B\) satisfying the admissibility conditions in \(\mathrm{lem:graphical\mbox{-}replacement\mbox{-}preservation}\), there exists \(\widetilde\eta\in\operatorname{Real}(\eta,B)\) such that \(A(\widetilde\eta)=A(\eta)\) and \(\mathcal O(\widetilde\eta)=\mathcal O(\eta)=\mathcal O\). Hence \(\widetilde\eta\) has the well-defined observational selected law \(P_{\widetilde\eta}^{(0)}=\mathcal L_{\widetilde\eta}(X\mid S^*=\mathbf 1)\) and, for every \(k\in[K]\), a faithful pooled law \(P_{\widetilde\eta,k}^{\mathrm{pool}}\); it preserves every adjacency and every unshielded collider on every full domain \(U_k\), including all \(\zeta_k\)-involving instances, and for every \(k\in[K]\) satisfies \(Z_k=T_k(\widetilde\eta)\cup((F_k(\widetilde\eta)\setminus T_k(\widetilde\eta))\cap A(\widetilde\eta))\). No equality between \(\kappa(\widetilde\eta)\) and \(\kappa(\eta)\) is required.
body.justification: This synthesis theorem supplies a fully specified replacement model with the same complete oracle signature and ancestral selected set.
body.gap: Published equivalence results do not prove existence of faithful selected-law realizations for a synchronized replacement specification.
body.consumer: It supplies valid whole-family witnesses for selected-selected circles in the sciPlex2 graph.

obligation.what_is_open: Turn the proved graphical replacement specification into a fully specified member of \(\operatorname{Real}(\eta,B)\cap\mathcal C(\mathcal O)\).
obligation.obstruction: The graphical proof fixes the projected signatures, but membership in \(\mathcal C(\mathcal O)\) additionally requires the unresolved jointly faithful kernel family in \(\mathrm{lem:simultaneous\mbox{-}faithful\mbox{-}realization}\).
obligation.attempted: Combined the graphical preservation conclusion with arbitrary strictly positive stable kernels. This establishes factorization, stability, and positive selection but not the reverse, faithfulness direction of every pooled-law conditional-independence equivalence.
obligation.partial_result: The proved graphical replacement lemma constructs, for every admissible \(B\), one acyclic replacement specification with the same \(A(\eta)\), every regime skeleton, every unshielded collider, and every indicator neighborhood.  Conditional on the still-unproved simultaneous-faithful-realization assertion, selecting its model \(\widetilde\eta\in\operatorname{Real}(\eta,B)\) and applying \(\mathrm{def:oracle\mbox{-}signature}\) gives \(\mathcal O(\widetilde\eta)=\mathcal O\) and hence the entire conclusion of \(\mathrm{lem:replacement\mbox{-}preservation}\).  Thus the sole remaining implication is from the graphical replacement specification to a jointly faithful shared-kernel member of \(\mathfrak M_{D,K}^{\mathrm{Dai}}\).
